build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cd storefront && npm install --no-audit --no-fund && npm run build && cd .. && cd src-tauri/sidecar/whatsapp-sidecar && npm install --omit=dev && node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync(process.execPath,'node.exe')"

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:3131 https://github.com https://*.githubusercontent.com https://quranapi.pages.dev; media-src 'self' https://github.com https://*.githubusercontent.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: blob: http: https:; font-src 'self'

bundle.longDescription: ZANPOS is a modern, local-first point-of-sale system built for Windows. Designed for Bahraini and Gulf retail businesses with BHD currency support, thermal receipt printing, WhatsApp notifications, AI-powered business insights, and multi-terminal LAN sync.
